invariants.rationale: It is likely that the method expects a non-null list of keys to delete, as processing a null value may lead to NullPointerException.
A non-null commit instant time is typically required for versioned data operations like delete.
This expresses that keys, if non-null, is either empty or non-empty, covering all scenarios and may be relevant for method branching. (Includes both cases to avoid assuming non-empty input.)
The instantTime string is likely used as an identifier; it being non-empty is important for the operation.
Lists of keys for data modification operations typically do not expect any null entries in the collection.
